- **S&P 500 (12/31/2011):** $85.65

## Five Year Total Return Calculation

### Ball Corporation
- Initial Value (12/31/2007): $100.00
- Final Value (12/31/2012): $207.62
- Total Return: 
  \[ \frac{207.62 - 100.00}{100.00} \times 100 = 107.62\% \]

### DJ US Containers & Packaging Index
- Initial Value (12/31/2007): $100.00
- Final Value (12/31/2012): $107.76
- Total Return: 
  \[ \frac{107.76 - 100.00}{100.00} \times 100 = 7.76\% \]

### Difference in Total Return
- Ball Corporation Total Return: 107.62%
- DJ US Containers & Packaging Index Total Return: 7.76%
- Difference: 
  \[ 107.62\% - 7.76\% = 99.86\% \]

**Source:**
- BLL fiscal 2012 annual report (10-K), page 31
- Management commentary, BLL fiscal 2012 results
